values./items/1/system/effect: Combat Armor Chest Piece, Combat Armor Leg x2, Combat Armor Arm x2, Combat Rifle, Wealth 2
values./items/12/system/description: A pre-War weapon found across the wastelands and used in large numbers by various aggressive factions. Combat Rifles are a rugged and adaptable design, able to be modified to fill a variety of different battlefield roles.
values./items/13/system/description: Before the Great War, double-barrel shotguns were mainly used for hunting and home defense, and this has changed little. They are break-action and come in an either a side-by-side or over-and-under barrel configuration. Simple to make and maintain, these shotguns are seen frequently in the Commonwealth and the rest of the wasteland.
values./items/14/system/description: Consisting of a glass bottle—normally from an alcoholic beverage—containing a flammable fuel mixture, a bit of motor oil to help it spread, and an alcohol-soaked rag stuffed in the top to act as a wick. When used, the wick is ignited and the bottle hurled at the target; the breaking bottle spreads the agitated mixture, which quickly ignites begins to burn anything in the vicinity. Cheap and effective.
values./items/15/system/description: Once per combat, the mercenary may ‘let rip’ with a volley from their Combat Rifle. This adds the weapon’s Fire Rate of 2 to the weapon’s damage for a single attack (for 7 CD total).
values./system/biography:
Wastelanders

The wasteland is filled with survivors of varying backgrounds, beliefs, and affiliations. From the merchants who keep goods moving between settlements, to the minute men helping to establish new communities, even down to the mercenaries and gunners who are out for the caps, there are a number of interesting people to encounter.

Mercenary

Sometimes thought of as the people’s militia, the Minutemen were once a prominent faction throughout the Commonwealth. Their influence has dwindled in recent years however but several them still do what they can to help those in need. From helping to establish settlements and then defending them from dangers, the sight of a Minute Man is always welcome.
